On The 12 th Of November, 2024

 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Manu V. John - Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri C.M.Tiwari - G.A for the respondent/State.

Order 
This is second criminal appeal filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989 against the order dated 22.05.2024 passed by Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, District Seoni (M.P.) whereby appellant's bail application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. in relation to Crime No.234/2024 registered at Police Station Bandol District Seoni (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 201, 506 of IPC, Sections 3(1) (w)(i) & 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and section 67(A) of IT Act was dismissed.

sentences.text: Appellant is in jail since 05.05.2024.
2. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 05.05.2024.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix is major lady.
She is consenting party.
There is delay in lodging FIR and there is no satisfactory explanation of delay.
He has filed an affidavit in which Prosecutrix has stated that she has no objection if the applicant is enlarged on bail.
Charge sheet has filed.
The conclusion of trial will take considerable time.
Hence, the appellant may be enlarged on bail.

3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55828 2 CRA-8689-2024 for grant of bail and prayed for its rejection on the ground of his criminal record.

4. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and the submission put forth by learned counsel for the appellant and in the light of material on record but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it a fit case for grant of bail.

Consequently,
this appeal under Section 14-A of the SC/ST Act is allowed.

sentences.text: 5. It is directed that appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
6.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
